story?Great!So, the story is about the typhoon Kitty and Ben met with.Was it a typhoon at the very beginning?Then, how did the wind change?Now, look at task 2 on your worksheet.Read the story again and find the sentences about the changes of the wind and complete the table.You will have one minute.The story is about the typhoon Kitty and Ben met with.Then, look at task 2 on your worksheet.Read the story again and find the sentences about the typhoon Kitty and Ben met with.Before the typhoon, how was the wind?At first, the wind blew gently.Here, gently is the adverb of the word gentle.It means 温和的。Please read after the recording.Gently.Again.So, the wind blew gently at first.Then, how did it change?Suddenly, the wind became stronger.Here, we have a new word suddenly.It means 突然。Suddenly.How was the wind during the typhoon?The wind blew fiercely.Here, the word fiercely means 猛烈的。Fiercely.How was the wind after the typhoon?Maybe you can't find a sentence to tell you the answer directly.But you can find a sentence like this.The typhoon passed quickly.Here, pass means go or move.In Chinese, we say 行进,移动。Pass.So, after the typhoon passed, there was a gentle wind or there was no wind, right?In the story, the wind changed a lot.Besides the wind, what other changes can you find in the story?Think about it.In the story, besides the wind, these things also changed.Where Kitty and Ben were.What Kitty and Ben did.And what happened around.Where Kitty and Ben were tells us where the story happened.The changes of Kitty and Ben's actions and all the things around tell us what happened in the story.Fantastic.You have found out what changed in the story.Now, please focus on the detailed information.Take out your worksheet.Look at task 3.Read the story.If
